Theme

Money, work & business · Civic life: news, government & the law

agreement noun

an arrangement between people

also deal, pact, arrangement, as agreed, terms, keep an agreement, accord, convention (between states), settlement (of a dispute), settle a dispute, let’s make a deal, make a deal

classical

Cic. Off. 3.92: pacta et prōmissa semperne servanda sint
Cic. Att. 6.3.1: ex pactō et conventō (Lewis & Short)

pactum, pactī n.

noun, second declension

an agreement, a pact

As agreed, ex pactō; to keep to an agreement, stāre pactō (Liv. 9.11, Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • pactiō, pactiōnis f. — an agreement, a bargain

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 4.18.2: pactiōnem cum aliquō facere (Lewis & Short); Cic. Rosc. Com. 34: pactiōnem facere dē aliquā rē (Lewis & Short); Traupman 301

    The making of an agreement and the agreement made: pactiōnem facere, to make a deal.

  • condiciō, condiciōnis f. — a term of an agreement; terms

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 295; Phaedr. 3.13.12: apibus condiciō placet

  • conventiō, conventiōnis f. — an agreement, a formal accord (between states)

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Liv. 27.30.12: contrā fidem conventiōnis; M-O s.v. treaty: agreement, accord, convention (diplomatic)

  • compositiō, compositiōnis f. — a settlement: the making up of a dispute

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Phil. 2.24: pācis, concordiae, compositiōnis auctor esse nōn dēstitī; M-O s.v. deal: settlement

    A peaceful accommodation, an agreement that ends a quarrel or a war (Lewis & Short); to settle a dispute is contrōversiam compōnere (M-O s.v. amicable). Its first sense is a putting together, an arrangement.

Examples

  • Pacta et prōmissa semperne servanda sint, quae nec vī nec dolō malō, ut praetōrēs solent, facta sint.

    Whether agreements and promises made, as the praetors put it, without force or fraud must always be kept.Cic. Off. 3.92

  • fūcī recūsant: apibus condiciō placet

    the drones refuse; the bees accept the termsPhaedr. 3.13.12

  • Pactiōnem faciāmus.

    Let’s make a deal.Traupman 134

See also agree, agree, contract, according to.
